description: This Java class 'EcuStimulator' provides functionality for testing and building fuel or timing tables for an ECU, including measurement collection, parameter setting, and UI integration.

classes.name: EcuStimulator
classes.description: Main class for ECU stimulation, measurement collection, and table generation with UI integration.

classes.name: EcuStimulator.ResultListener
classes.description: Interface for handling measurement results callback.

classes.name: EcuStimulator.MultipleMeasurements
classes.description: Helper class to store multiple dwell and advance measurements.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Generates measurement data over RPM and engine load ranges, logs results, and writes data as C array.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Iterates over RPM, engine load, and coolant temperature to test points and collect measurements.

methods.name: testPoint
methods.description: Sets parameters, waits for measurements, sorts and selects median values, and invokes result callback.

methods.name: sleepRuntime
methods.description: Pauses thread execution for specified milliseconds.

methods.name: setRpm
methods.description: Requests RPM change and verifies actual RPM, retries up to 10 times.

methods.name: setPotVoltage
methods.description: Adjusts potentiometer voltage via commands, verifies actual voltage if sensor provided.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs message to MessagesCentral and FileLog.

methods.name: putValue
methods.description: Formats message string with delimiter and value.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Creates a UI button to trigger table building in a separate thread.

methods.name: waitForMultipleResults
methods.description: Collects multiple dwell and advance measurements asynchronously.
